description: Lärmemissionen auf den Strassen des Kantons St.Gallen (LBK_LAERMEMISSION) is a dataset listed in St.Gallen open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Amt für Raumentwicklung und Geoinformation (SG). Der Datensatz zeigt einen Auszug aus dem Strassenlärmbelastungskataster (LBK) des Kantons St.Gallen, die Emissionen. Er entspricht dem Layer LBKLAERMEMISSION. Die Emissionen, im LBK als Immissionslinien dargestellt, liefern die Grundlage für die Abschätzung der Strassenlärmbelastung bei einzelnen Liegenschaften und dienen als Basis für die Erstellung von Lärmbeurteilungen. Coverage: Canton of St. Gallen. The portal files it under Mobility and Transport, Territory and environment. Its keywords are larm, emissionen, Geschwindigkeit, Fahrzeug, Tunnel, Brücken. The portal shows 11,452 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-09-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-daten-sg-ch-portal.
